点底座切换风速 · 拖动旋转观察: Click the base to change speed · drag to rotate
点电源开始 · 也可先选择风速: Press Power to start · or choose a speed first
电源已关 · 叶片惯性停转中: Power off · blades coasting to a stop
电源开启，清风将至: Power on. The breeze is coming.
电源关闭，叶片慢慢停下: Power off. The blades slowly stop.
摇头已开启 · 开机后生效: Oscillation enabled · takes effect after power-on
电源断开，叶片已停稳。先选风档，再开机，观察转速逐渐追上目标。: Power off and blades stopped. Choose a speed, then power on to watch actual speed approach the target.
电机不再驱动，但叶片不会立刻停下；余速逐渐减小。: The motor no longer drives the blades, but they do not stop instantly. Remaining speed gradually decreases.
摇头也随传动慢下来。: Oscillation slows with the same drive.
风档改变的是目标转速；电机带动叶片逐渐加速或减速，不会瞬间跳档。: A speed setting changes the target. The motor accelerates or slows the blades gradually rather than instantly.
电机带动叶片保持转动，弯曲的叶片推动空气。: The motor keeps the blades turning; their curved shape pushes air.
摇头机构借用同一传动，让机头往复偏转。: The same drive powers the mechanism that swings the head back and forth.
摇头关闭时，机头停在当前方向，叶片仍可独立转动。: With oscillation off, the head holds its direction while the blades can keep turning independently.
对比风档、惯性停转与摇头。读数来自模型当前运动，不是风档的预设值；慢放只改变演示: Compare speed settings, coasting and oscillation. Readouts use the model's current motion, not preset values. Slow viewing changes demonstration speed only.
电源已断，叶片仍转；观察它逐渐停稳。: Power is off but the blades still turn. Watch them gradually stop.
摇头也会随余速减小而停止。: Oscillation stops as the remaining speed falls.
机头保持当前朝向。: The head holds its current direction.
机头左右偏转，叶片继续转；关摇头会保留当前朝向。: The head swings while the blades turn. Stopping oscillation keeps the current direction.
看叶片逐渐追上目标，再换档比较；电机和摇头机构需转到侧后方观察。: Watch speed approach the target, then compare settings. Rotate toward the back to inspect the motor and oscillator.
开机 · 看转速追上目标: Power on · watch speed approach target
只改变目标转速，不瞬间改变叶片速度: Changes target speed, not blade speed instantly
预选风档，开机后生效: Preselect a speed; it takes effect at power-on
只切换原有摇头开关，不改变风档: Uses the existing oscillation switch without changing speed
退出对照 · 保留当前风档与运动: Leave comparison · keep current speed and motion
可随时换档、断电或切换摇头，没有固定顺序。数值是模型转速，不是实物性能；退出不关: Change speed, power or oscillation in any order. Values are model speeds, not real-product performance. Leaving does not power off.
直接点底座按钮，或在这里操作。: Use the base buttons directly, or the controls here.
拖动风扇，看看它的每一面。: Drag the fan to inspect every side.
直接点底座按钮开关电源、切换风速；转到侧后方，点机头上的小旋钮，开启或关闭摇头。: Use the base buttons for power and speed. Rotate toward the rear and click the small head knob to switch oscillation.
拖动风扇，转一转视角；双击空白处或点“重置视角”回到起点。: Drag the fan to rotate the view. Double-click empty space or choose Reset view to return.
选中风扇后，用方向键转动视角，空格键开关电源。: Focus the fan, use arrows to rotate and Space to switch power.
旋转的叶片推动空气，摇头机构让风走得更远。: Rotating blades push air; oscillation spreads it across a wider direction.
手绘电风扇，拖动旋转视角，底座按钮和机头旋钮可直接操作: Hand-drawn fan. Drag to rotate; operate the base buttons and head knob directly.
